subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Unboxing Moment
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Unboxing Moment.

hook.text: A customer opens a beautifully packaged box with a handwritten thank-you note. They post it on Instagram.

buildup.text: The unboxing experience is the customer's first physical interaction with a brand after ordering online.

discovery.text: Custom packaging, inserts, and presentation turn a box into a brand moment that drives word-of-mouth.

twist.text: Overpackaging frustrates eco-conscious customers. The line between impressive and wasteful is thin.

climax.text: Apple's packaging is designed so the lid lifts slowly—engineering an emotional reveal worth billions in brand value.

punchline.text: The box is the first impression. Make it count.

quiz.question: Why is the unboxing experience important for brands?
options: It creates a brand moment that drives word-of-mouth
